title: Correcting Attribution Patching with a Few Exact Measurements
abstract: arXiv:2610.27393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability asks which language model components matter for a behavior, and activation patching answers by changing one component's activation and measuring its effect, at a cost growing with components and prompts. Attribution patching estimates these effects from one gradient pass, but its estimates can be far off, and verifying each one restores the cost. Can the structure of these errors reduce this cost? We propose Guided-AP, which uses a few exact measurements to reveal attribution patching's errors and correct unmeasured estimates. On a single prompt, many components' errors share one sign, so a small exact sample yields one correction for the rest. Over many prompts of one task, components are misestimated similarly, so a few measured prompts show what to verify and how to correct each component's average effect. Our analysis shows that choosing what to verify needs error size, while correction also needs sign. O

translated_title: 用少量精确测量修正归因补丁
translated_abstract: 机制可解释性研究哪些语言模型组件对某种行为起关键作用，激活补丁通过改变单个组件的激活并测量其效果来回答这一问题，但其成本随组件和提示数量的增加而增长。归因补丁仅需一次梯度传递即可估计这些效果，但其估计可能偏差很大，而逐一验证又会恢复原有成本。这些误差的结构能否降低这一成本？我们提出了Guided-AP，它利用少量精确测量来揭示归因补丁的误差，并据此修正未测量的估计。在单个提示上，许多组件的误差具有相同的符号，因此少量精确样本即可为其余组件提供一个统一的修正。在同一任务的多个提示上，各组件被错误估计的方式相似，因此少量已测量的提示可以指示需要验证哪些组件，以及如何修正每个组件的平均效果。我们的分析表明，选择需要验证的对象需要误差大小信息，而进行修正还需要误差符号信息。
tldr: 提出Guided-AP方法，利用少量精确测量揭示归因补丁误差的结构规律（误差符号一致性），从而以极低的额外成本修正大量未测量组件的估计，大幅降低机制可解释性中激活补丁的计算开销。
en_tdlr: Guided-AP leverages a few exact measurements to reveal the structured errors of attribution patching and correct unmeasured estimates, drastically reducing the cost of activation patching in mechanistic interpretability.
